newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LATE ANGLOMA GOAL SAVES INTER EMBARRASSMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE ANGLOMA GOAL SAVES INTER EMBARRASSMENT.

text.p: Jocelyn Angloma scored a late goal to give Internazionale a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Austrian lightweights Casino Graz in their UEFA Cup second round, first leg on Tuesday.
But the French striker's moment of glory was short-lived when he appeared to strain a muscle as he celebrated his 81st minute strike. The injury forced him out of the match.
Inter's class team struggled to assert themselves against Casino Graz, appearing in the second round of a European competition for the first time.
Fine saves from goalkeeper Manninger kept the Austrians in with a chance until Angloma's well-directed header from a Ciriaco Sforza corner broke the deadlock.
